answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the shale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. The pulse lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the terrace is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short.
